structure.unit: State Agencies Related to the General Operation of Government

law.catch_line: Unpresented checks drawn by State Treasurer; replacement and payment
law.text: The State Treasurer shall report and remit, pursuant to the provisions of §§ 55.1-2517 and 55.1-2524, all checks drawn by him on state depositories that have not been presented for payment within one year from the date of issuance.
